name: the custodian
antecedent: At a fictional tenants' association she kept minutes. A neighbor withdrew from meetings after an unsigned demand went out under everyone's name. She still wants dissidents to get a hearing.

name: the discussion leader
antecedent: At a fictional evening school she learned to keep a discussion going after someone said something ugly. She came to rely on a listener having the means to answer back. She can mistake silence for being denied that opportunity.
